history.summary: CSV OVERREACH FLAG — No documented temple named 'Shri Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga' exists in Godhra. The Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga is at Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh (~225 km east); none of the twelve Jyotirlingas is at Godhra, so the 'Jyotirlinga' label cannot apply to any local shrine. No local Mahakaleshwar-named temple appears in Godhra travel guides, place listings or the town's documented temple roster (Godhra's known Shiva shrines include the Ankleshwar Mahadev temple and the Kankeshwar Temple nearby). The CSV row is most likely a mislabelled local Shiva/Mahadev shrine or a compilation error. Coordinates below are for Godhra town (approximate). This file must not be presented as a Jyotirlinga; needs renaming or removal by the user.

name: Shri Mahakaleshwar Temple, Godhra (identity unconfirmed — NOT the Ujjain Jyotirlinga)
town_description: Godhra is the administrative headquarters of Panchmahal district in eastern Gujarat and a major railway junction. The town is a noted Vaishnav centre, hosting four Pushtimarg bethaks, and has a layered Hindu, Jain and Muslim heritage.

travel.airport: Vadodara Airport (~110 km southwest); Ahmedabad Airport (~140 km west)
travel.railway: Godhra Junction (GDA), on the Delhi-Mumbai line
travel.road: NH 47 and the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway pass through Godhra; well connected by state buses
